title: Framed Player Inputs
description: This project makes your client side inputs register every frame.
body:
This mod makes your inputs register every frame instead of every tick, so inputs feel smoother. You for example go into third person faster than without this mod. This mod is very useful for low tickrate worlds or servers, where inputs are even slower than normal.

This mod only makes the following actions register every frame:
- Opening and closing chat
- Toggle perspective
- Open inventory
- Dropping item with keybind
- Swapping item with offhand with keybind
- Changing hotbar slots
